text: {"overall_winner": "B", "qualities": [{"evidence": "multi-paragraph essay with clear introduction, body paragraphs, counterargument, and conclusion", "quality": "Structural Organization", "description": "Captures the ability to arrange writing logically into distinct sections that guide the reader through an argument."}, {"evidence": "use of transitional phrases such as \"Because of this\", \"The first reason\", \"The second and probably most important reason\", and \"In conclusion\"", "quality": "Cohesive Transitional Devices", "description": "Captures the clear linking of ideas and paragraphs using varied connective words and phrases."}, {"evidence": "phrases like \"exhausted and depleted mentally\", \"explore this career path\", and \"hypothetically have a year-round school year\"", "quality": "Vocabulary Sophistication and Range", "description": "Captures the selection and correct deployment of precise, varied, and context-appropriate diction."}, {"evidence": "complex sentences with varied clause structures versus Essay A's run-on listing of activities using \"and going to\"", "quality": "Sentence Structure Variety", "description": "Captures the effective construction of diverse sentence types that maintain syntactic control without relying on repetitive run-on patterns."}, {"evidence": "consistent punctuation and capital letters at sentence boundaries compared to Essay A's complete lack of sentence-ending punctuation", "quality": "Punctuation Mechanics", "description": "Captures the accurate use of periods, commas, and capitalization to mark sentence boundaries."}]}
